fusions.name: Drenching Shake
fusions.desc: Shakes the water from your coat in a 4-tile cone, dealing 12 water damage to everything caught, knocking it 2 tiles back and leaving it [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Puddle Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks a splash of water at the target for 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it instead.

fusions.name: Dry-Shod

riders.text: you move 10% faster over it than over ground
and your dodge chance is 8% higher while you are on it
and your health regenerates 15% faster while you are on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 8%, and from gold your health regenerates 15% faster.
